## FIN_06 — She was there

| id | speaker | line | direction |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FIN_06_01` | 7 | They weren’t showing me someone else’s life. |  |

| `FIN_06_03` | 7 | I was there. | A long breath |
| `FIN_06_04` | 7 | The gardens. The bridge. That little bird… | Wonder and grief together |
| `FIN_06_05` | 7 | I knew them. |  |
